skills.name: netclaw-diagnostics
skills.description: Netclaw diagnostics and session debugging. Read when the user wants to understand what happened in a Netclaw session, why a tool failed, why capabilities are missing, or whether daemon/memory/config health is degraded.

skills.name: netclaw-identity
skills.description: Netclaw identity files. Read when the user wants to update lasting profile, tone, workflow, or environment preferences that should shape future Netclaw sessions.

skills.name: netclaw-manual
skills.description: Netclaw Manual. Read when the user is asking what Netclaw can do, which command/tool to use, how to schedule work, switch models, manage providers, or discover available capabilities.

skills.name: netclaw-memory
skills.description: Netclaw memory usage. Read when the user asks what Netclaw remembers, wants something saved for later, or when you need to decide between automatic recall, explicit memory search, and identity-file updates.

skills.name: search-citation
skills.description: Guides when to use web search vs. training data and how to cite sources. Ensures specific factual claims include source URLs and the agent does not hallucinate verifiable information.

skills.name: skill-authoring
skills.description: Create a skill when a repeatable workflow emerges. Read for file format, naming, and discovery conventions.
